items.title: StreamLedger
items.description: Event-sourced, CQRS ledger for balances and inventory. Optimistic concurrency stops double-spends, and dedupe keys make retried commands safe. 48+ tests run fully in memory.

items.title: agentgate
items.description: Gateway between LLM agents and internal APIs, with per-agent policy rules, Redis-backed rate limits and cost budgets, and a Postgres audit log with replay.

items.title: sentinel-triage
items.description: Correlates auth and endpoint logs into incidents, matches Sigma rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and measures precision, recall and false-positive rate on a labeled dataset.

items.title: Text Analysis with NLP
items.description: Interactive Streamlit app for text preprocessing, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, part-of-speech tagging and word clouds.
